verdict.rationale: Datalab's structured extraction fills a user-provided JSON schema, and the docs claim fields come back with citations to source bounding boxes for auditability. That covers the bounding-box part of the provenance story. The claim is a single landing-page line, though, with no documented response format showing per-field page numbers or source snippets. Missing for 10: explicit per-field page number, source text snippet, a documented citation schema in the extract API reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
